blurb: Discover a hands-on cocktail experience with seasonal mixology classes in Las Vegas, where guests learn to craft signature drinks using premium spirits and fresh ingredients. Each session includes expert-led tastings and interactive stations, and depending on the time of year, could have rotating themes like Spooky Spirits, Fall Flavors, Christmas Cheer, Tiki Drinks and Prohibition Pleasers. Perfect for cocktail lovers of all levels, this immersive class combines creativity, flavor and fun in a one-of-a-kind Vegas activity.
